We will denote the relationship with $X \rightarrow Y$ if $X$ is a determinant of $Y$, where both $X$ and $Y$ can be a set of attributes. excerpt: There's been a long-standing issue with the installinator where reports to wicketd get delayed quite substantially. title: pgwire: fix flaky pgwire metrics by biasing select! in send_rows
excerpt: The `tokio::select!` in `send_rows` had a nondeterministic race between `recv()` (stream end) and `sleep_until` (expired WaitOnce deadline). When both futures were simultaneously ready—e.g., FETCH ALL on a finite cursor—tokio would randomly pick one. If the deadline won, `no_more_rows` was never set on the stream, so the `mz_result_rows_first_to_last_byte_seconds` metric was silently skipped. Fix by adding `biased;` and reordering branches so data is always drained before checking the deadline.
